description.zh: 用统一的多场景视觉布局解释仿真与真实机器人评估范围。
description.en: A visual organization pattern for simulated and physical robot evaluation coverage.

zh: 需要呈现大量任务类别与评估场景
en: Presenting multiple robot task families or evaluation environments

zh: 建立任务类别间明确视觉分组
不要暗示不同任务的测试条件完全一致
en: Do not imply incomparable settings are identical

label.zh: 真实来源图 · 原作者版权所有

insight.zh: 评测型工作最重要的是让读者迅速知道评了什么、在什么条件下评、为何仿真与现实共同必要。
insight.en: A benchmark overview should answer what is tested, under which conditions, and why simulated and physical evaluations complement one another.

zh: 将 42 项仿真任务与 18 项真实任务分为两个清楚的视觉区。
先体现任务多样性，再说明泛化、记忆、精度、长时程与开放指令这五个维度。
机器人、任务和环境的对应关系要明确，不要只堆满场景小图。
en: Keep 42 simulation tasks and 18 real-world tasks in visibly distinct groups.
Show task diversity before listing generalization, memory, precision, long-horizon and open instruction following.
Use unambiguous robot-task-environment labels, not an unlabeled image collage.

zh: 定义评估维度与仿真/真实范围。
每个任务组选取具有代表性的真实素材，并注明平台与条件。
使用统计汇总说明覆盖面，不能将任务数量当成性能分数。
en: Define axes and simulation/real evaluation scope.
Choose representative, licensed visuals and label the platform and setup.
Summarize coverage accurately; task counts are not performance scores.

zh: 42/18 为官网描述的任务数量，不能推断每项任务难度相等。
官网外链媒体图片不能从代码仓库的 MIT 许可自动推断授权。
en: The 42/18 figures refer to official task counts, not matched task difficulty.
An MIT license on a software repo does not automatically license externally hosted imagery.
